cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating that the instance node is null or missing
cases.description: When the supplied JsonNode is null the method should short‑circuit and return a ValidationResult with an appropriate error message rather than attempting further validation.

group: Valid Type Validation (has TypeValidator, matching type)

cases.expected: ValidationResult with no ValidationMessage (empty set) because the node type matches the schema's TypeValidator
cases.description: The schema contains a TypeValidator that expects an object. The supplied node is a JSON object, so type validation passes and no error messages are produced.

group: Invalid Type Validation (has TypeValidator, mismatching type)

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage stating that the instance type is not allowed by the schema's TypeValidator
cases.description: The schema expects an object (or another specific type) but the supplied node is a JSON string; the TypeValidator should generate a validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage that required property "name" is missing
cases.description: The schema defines a required property "name". An empty object is supplied, so the RequiredValidator should add a missing‑property error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with an empty ValidationMessage set because all required properties are present
cases.description: The node satisfies the required properties of the schema, therefore no required‑property errors are emitted.

cases.expected: ValidationResult that does not enter infinite recursion and contains validation messages only for the outer object (e.g., no StackOverflowError)
cases.description: When the schema is marked as a recursive anchor, the validator must recognise the `$ref` to itself and avoid endless recursion, returning a proper ValidationResult.

cases.expected: ValidationResult where the mock WalkListenerRunner's `run` method has been called exactly once with the appropriate context
cases.description: If a WalkListenerRunner is configured, `validateAndCollect` must invoke it during validation. The test verifies that the runner is called.

cases.expected: ValidationResult that contains a ValidationMessage indicating that the schema resource root was used (or simply succeeds without extra processing)
cases.description: When the schema is flagged as a resource root, the validator may apply special handling (e.g., base URI resolution). The test ensures this branch is exercised.

cases.expected: ValidationResult reflecting the modifications performed by a custom ExecutionContext (e.g., a custom format validator is added and triggers an extra ValidationMessage)
cases.description: Passing a custom ExecutionContext (via the overloaded public method) can change validation behavior. This case verifies that the customizer’s effects are visible in the result.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with no ValidationMessage because the $ref resolves to a definition that validates the referenced value (e.g., a string) correctly.
cases.description: The schema contains a definition "name" of type string. The instance uses $ref to point to that definition. validateAndCollect should resolve the $ref and apply the referenced validators, resulting in a successful validation.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating type mismatch (expected integer) because the referenced definition expects an integer but the instance provides an object.
cases.description: The $ref resolves to a definition that expects an integer. The supplied node is an object, so the validator should report a type error after $ref resolution.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the value is one of the allowed enum values ["RED","GREEN","BLUE"].
cases.description: The schema defines an enum of three colour strings. The instance supplies a matching value, so validation succeeds.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage stating that the value is not one of the allowed enum values.
cases.description: The instance provides a value not present in the enum list, triggering an enum validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the instance equals the const value defined in the schema.
cases.description: The schema uses "const": 42. The instance matches exactly, so validation passes.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating that the instance does not equal the const value 42.
cases.description: The instance differs from the const value, causing a const validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the string matches the regex pattern "^[A-Z]{2}\d{4}$".
cases.description: The schema defines a pattern that requires two uppercase letters followed by four digits. The instance satisfies the pattern.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating pattern mismatch.
cases.description: The instance uses lowercase letters, violating the defined regex pattern.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the number lies within the inclusive range [10,20].
cases.description: The schema defines "minimum":10 and "maximum":20. The instance value 15 satisfies both constraints.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage stating that the value is less than the minimum of 10.
cases.description: The instance is below the allowed minimum, triggering a minimum validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage stating that the value exceeds the maximum of 20.
cases.description: The instance exceeds the defined maximum, causing a maximum validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because array length (3) is between minItems=2 and maxItems=5.
cases.description: The schema restricts array length to a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 5. The supplied array satisfies both constraints.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating that the array has fewer items than the required minItems of 2.
cases.description: Array length is below the allowed minimum, resulting in a validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating that the array exceeds the maxItems limit of 5.
cases.description: Array length exceeds the defined maximum, causing a validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the object contains only the defined property "allowed".
cases.description: The schema defines a property "allowed" and sets "additionalProperties": false. The instance complies.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage stating that property "extra" is not allowed (additionalProperties = false).
cases.description: The instance contains an extra property not defined in the schema, which should be rejected.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the string conforms to the "date-time" format.
cases.description: The schema specifies "format": "date-time". The supplied ISO‑8601 string is valid.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage indicating that the value does not match the "date-time" format.
cases.description: The string does not follow the required date‑time format, leading to a format validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the string is of type string, meets minLength=4, and matches pattern "^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}$".
cases.description: The schema applies three validators simultaneously. The instance satisfies all, resulting in no errors.

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing two ValidationMessages: one for minLength violation (length 3 < 4) and one for pattern mismatch.
cases.description: The instance fails both the minimum length and pattern validators, so both errors should be reported.

group: Keyword Walk Listener Runner Null (No Invocation)

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set and no interaction with WalkListenerRunner (i.e., no NPE, listener not called).
cases.description: When keywordWalkListenerRunner is null, validateAndCollect should execute normally without attempting to invoke a listener.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with empty ValidationMessage set because the $id of the current schema resolves the relative reference correctly.
cases.description: The schema defines an "$id": "http://example.com/schemas/". The instance uses a relative $ref. Validation should resolve the reference using the base URI derived from $id and succeed.

group: ExecutionContext Customizer Adding Custom Format Validator

cases.expected: ValidationResult containing a ValidationMessage produced by the custom format validator (e.g., "custom-format" error) while other validators pass.
cases.description: A custom ExecutionContext adds a validator for a made‑up format "custom-format". The instance does not satisfy this format, so the custom validator should contribute an error to the result.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the $ref URI is syntactically invalid and URLDecoder fails to parse it
cases.description: The schema contains a $ref with characters that are not allowed in a URI. When validateAndCollect attempts to resolve the reference it uses URLDecoder, which throws IllegalArgumentException for malformed URIs.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when the private validateAndCollect(ExecutionContext, JsonNode, ...) overload is invoked with a null ExecutionContext
cases.description: Using reflection to call the private overload with a null ExecutionContext should cause the method to dereference the context and throw NPE. This verifies that the method does not silently accept a null context.

group: External schema reference not found – JsonProcessingException

cases.expected: JsonProcessingException (wrapped in a RuntimeException) because the referenced external schema file cannot be located or parsed
cases.description: The instance contains a $ref that points to an external JSON schema file that does not exist on the classpath. During resolution the validator attempts to read the file and fails, resulting in a JsonProcessingException.

group: Custom validator throws unchecked exception – propagation

cases.expected: RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException) propagated out of validateAndCollect because a user‑supplied JsonValidator threw an unchecked exception during validation
cases.description: A schema is configured with a custom JsonValidator that deliberately throws an IllegalStateException when invoked. The test ensures that validateAndCollect does not swallow the exception but lets it propagate to the caller.

cases.expected: UnsupportedEncodingException thrown because the $id contains an illegal percent‑encoding sequence that URLDecoder cannot decode using the specified charset
cases.description: The schema defines an $id with malformed percent‑encoding. When validateAndCollect processes the $id it calls URLDecoder.decode with UTF‑8, which throws UnsupportedEncodingException for the illegal sequence.
